opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (for 2027, dairy and pig study tours are planned).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day study tour programme for young people aged 18-24 to develop their understanding of the farming industry, staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, building networks and future opportunities. Fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026.
